question: Who among the following became the youngest speaker of Lok Sabha till March 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ganti Mohana Chandra Balayogi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ganti Mohana Chandra Balayogi became the youngest speaker of Lok Sabha till March 2021**__.

 __
 
• **He had the distinction of having been elected Speaker of the Twelfth Lok Sabha and re-elected unanimously as the Speaker of the Thirteenth Lok Sabha.**
 
• He was handpicked by Telugu Desam Party (TDP) supremo N. Chandrababu Naidu in 1998 to become the youngest and first Dalit Speaker of the Lok Sabha.
 
• As Speaker, Balayogi was the Chairman of the Business Advisory Committee, Rules Committee and General Purposes Committee.
 
• Balayogi was also the Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Conference of Presiding Officers of Legislative Bodies in India.
 
• The Speaker is elected by the Lok Sabha from amongst its members.
 
 
• He is the protector of the members' rights and privileges, the House as a whole, and their committees.
 
• He appoints the chairman of all the parliamentary committees of the Lok Sabha and supervises their functioning.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Meira Kumar was the 15th Speaker** of Lok Sabha from 2009 to 2014.
 
• **Sumitra Mahajan was the 16th Speaker** of Lok Sabha from 2014 to 2019.
 
• **PA Sangma was the 11th Speaker **of Lok Sabha from from 1996 to 1998.
